get.summary: BPT top players by division (live RankedIn)
get.description: Aggregates finished organisation events from RankedIn, maps classes to seven BPT divisions, attaches latest BPT ranking points, and returns the top N players per division sorted by total ranking points. Players are keyed by RankedIn slug (rankedinId) only. No caching or database writes.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Max players returned per division (clamped to server max, default from config)

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: When set to 1, response includes a debug object (class mapping diagnostics, HTTP call counts, errors)

502.description: Aggregation failed (RankedIn unreachable or unexpected failure)
